label: lem:tilting-module-rigidity
title: Tilting module rigidity
html: Lemma (Tilting module rigidity). The extreme vertices of the collapsed spectrahedron are uniquely determined by the tilting modules of the Cemetery group. These modules act as invariant tensor structures. They restrict the kernel of G(q) and force the non-zero eigenvalues of the collapsed state to be generated exclusively by words in q and q^{-1}.
